name: Egyō
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 47); Porter’s note gives the dates as: late 10th century.

poems.title: My little temple stands alone
poems.author: Egyō
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 47
poems.text:
My little temple stands alone,
No other hut is near;
No one will pass to stop and praise
Its vine-grown roof, I fear,
Now that the autumn ’s here.
